company.shortDescription: RoundMenu was a Dubai-based restaurant discovery, reservation, and food delivery platform.
company.description: RoundMenu was a Dubai-based restaurant discovery, reservation, and food delivery platform that helped users find restaurants, browse menus, book tables, access dining deals, and order food online across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. The platform operated through web and mobile apps and expanded across multiple Arab countries before being acquired by Careem in 2018.
